title: de Seze et al., eLife 93180 — CPM observation ledger
global_rules: F bounds are visual reading precision, not confidence intervals or biological acceptance limits unless the statistic explicitly identifies an approximate observed point range.
Reporter amplitudes are normalized local-to-rest fluorescence ratios, not absolute GTPase concentrations or active fractions.
ROI-area measurements are not centroid displacement or speed.
Different reporters and successive means are not independent single-cell replicates.
Main-figure visual values come from preprint v2; do not label them as final-image-verified.
Keep the 35/40/10/25-percent prose inconsistency, movie-label issues, and reporter-rate uncertainty out of automated hard-target assignment.
Do not compare fold changes from distinct reporters as a common concentration or force scale, or infer pathway dominance solely from their numerical ratio.

measurement_operators.normalized_reporter: [mean(background_subtracted_signal in activated cell region)/mean(background_subtracted_signal in remaining cell region)] / corresponding prestimulus ratio
measurement_operators.RBD_model_filter: db/dt = k_off_reporter*(r_accessible_RhoA_GTP - b); author model, not direct raw signal equivalence

source_quality_flags.detail: Main text approximately 35+40+10+25 percent sums to 110; do not silently renormalize.
Several final movie captions label optoLARG in experiments discussed as optoPRG. Movies were not inspected.
Printed 0.08 ± 0.4 s^-1 conflicts with final Appendix 1 figure 1 spread. Central value retained; uncertainty unresolved.
Figure 2E prints um^2/min despite calling the quantity membrane mean speed. This is not linear translation speed.
Appendix reaction list prints a GDP label for a PH-binding reaction otherwise described by text and ODE as involving active GTP-bound RhoA.
